nadaverse: Browse Microdata Catalogs Using 'NADA' REST API

Source: R/nadaverse-package.R
nadaverse-package.Rd

Provides a unified, programmatic interface for searching, browsing, and retrieving metadata from data repositories that use the National Data Archive ('NADA') software, such as the World Bank, 'FAO', the International Household Survey Network ('IHSN'), 'UNHCR', the World Health Organization, and the statistics offices of Kenya and Zambia. Functions discover available data collections, country codes, and access types, search by keyword, country, and year, and retrieve study metadata, file lists, and variable-level data dictionaries.

Details

Start with catalogs to see the supported catalogs, then use search_catalog to find studies. Use metadata, data_files and data_dictionary to inspect a study. set_user_agent changes the user agent sent with requests.
